legal_units.title: Appointment of income-tax authorities.
legal_units.text: The Central Government may appoint such persons as it thinks fit to be income-tax authorities.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIV TAX ADMINISTRATION Chapter XIV, Division A Authorities, jurisdiction and functions Section 237 Appointment of income-tax authorities. Section 237(1): The Central Government may appoint such persons as it thinks fit to be income-tax authorities.

legal_units.title: Appointment of income-tax authorities.
legal_units.text: The Central Government may, subject to the rules and its orders regulating the conditions of service of persons in public services and posts, authorise the Board, or a Principal Director General or Director General, or a Principal Chief Commissioner or Chief Commissioner, or a Principal Director or Director, or a Principal Commissioner or Commissioner, to appoint income-tax authorities below the rank of a Deputy Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIV TAX ADMINISTRATION Chapter XIV, Division A Authorities, jurisdiction and functions Section 237 Appointment of income-tax authorities. Section 237(2): The Central Government may, subject to the rules and its orders regulating the conditions of service of persons in public services and posts, authorise the Board, or a Principal Director General or Director General, or a Principal Chief Commissioner or Chief Commissioner, or a Principal Director or Director, or a Principal Commissioner or Commissioner, to appoint income-tax authorities below the rank of a Deputy Commissioner or Assistant Commissioner.

legal_units.title: Appointment of income-tax authorities.
legal_units.text: Subject to the rules and orders of the Central Government regulating the conditions of service of persons in public services and posts, an income-tax authority authorised in this behalf by the Board, may appoint such executive or ministerial staff as may be necessary to assist it in the execution of its functions.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XIV TAX ADMINISTRATION Chapter XIV, Division A Authorities, jurisdiction and functions Section 237 Appointment of income-tax authorities. Section 237(3): Subject to the rules and orders of the Central Government regulating the conditions of service of persons in public services and posts, an income-tax authority authorised in this behalf by the Board, may appoint such executive or ministerial staff as may be necessary to assist it in the execution of its functions.
